ResearchProjectDef.label: hemalurgic precision
ResearchProjectDef.description: Deeper understanding of the bind points and spiritual anatomy allows the hemalurgist to place spikes with greater accuracy, reducing the risk of killing the donor during the charging process.

ResearchProjectDef.label: hemalurgic mastery
ResearchProjectDef.description: Mastery of hemalurgic art reveals the precise angles and depths required to pierce the spirit web without severing its host. A skilled surgeon can now charge spikes with minimal risk to the donor's life.
